title: 故郷 (Furusato — Hometown)
description: Japan's most cherished song of longing for home. The singer recalls childhood: chasing rabbits on the mountain, fishing small carp in the river — and vows to return someday to the blue hills and clear waters of their hometown. Published in 尋常小学唱歌 (Elementary School Songs), Vol. 6, 1914. Sung at graduations and gatherings across Japan to this day.
